notes.title: Very Early Alpha Public Playtest
notes.content:
Well, finally I have a basic playable map with the core mechanics.

As such, the game is now open for playtesting by the public (I will accept invitations as they come through).

You can use weapons/items and play multiplayer (ESC->host game / join game)

Controls are:
- Left mouse = Shoot nosecone laser (you can hold the button down)
- Right mouse = Teleport
- Middle mouse = melee attack with mining laser (hold it down)
- Spacebar = Shield, currently only works with projectiles

If you find a bug, or have an idea for a feature, let us know in the steam discussions

- OR -

Join the discord: https://discord.gg/nJ5u4awDWv
